name: Coinbase Exchange Public API
summary: Keyless public market data from the Coinbase Exchange: products, tickers, order books, candles, trades and currencies.
description: The public REST endpoints of Coinbase Exchange (formerly Coinbase Pro) list trading products and currencies and serve per-product tickers, order books at three levels, trades, 24-hour stats and historical candles. Public endpoints are throttled by IP and need no authentication; private endpoints need signed keys.

auth.notes: Public endpoints answered keyless; private endpoints need CB-ACCESS-* headers.

rate_limit.summary: Public endpoints: 10 requests per second per IP, bursts up to 15 (documented).

license.name: Coinbase terms (not re-confirmed for data reuse)

coverage.geographic: Global crypto products listed on Coinbase Exchange

agent_notes: Product ids are BASE-QUOTE like BTC-USD. Candles come back newest first as [time, low, high, open, close, volume]; granularity is in seconds (3600 was used in the check). Paging uses the cb-before and cb-after response headers. /products includes delisted pairs, so check status and trading_disabled.
caveats: Candle responses are arrays, with low before high and open, unlike most exchanges.
Delisted products stay in /products with trading_disabled true.
A per-request candle cap exists but its exact size was not re-confirmed.

verification.notes: Example executed keyless. /products, /book, /candles, /currencies/BTC and /trades also returned 200; CORS * on two origins.
